title: Club Membership: late fee base amount and repeat-delinquency escalation
content:
## Scope
This document states the Club Membership late fee's own tier base amount, and the escalation applied where the member has a recent history of prior late fee charges.

## Per-tier base amount
| Tier | Late fee base amount |
|---|---|
| Base Club Access | $15.00 |
| Student Metro Access | $10.00 |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | $15.00 |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | $15.00 |
| Premier All-Access | $15.00 |
| Black Card All-Access | $15.00 |
| Founding Legacy Access | $10.00 |

## Rule
When a scheduled recurring dues charge fails to collect and the membership is marked past due, a late fee charge is billed in the tier's own base amount shown above. Where the member has already incurred one or more prior late fee charges within the trailing 12 months ending at the moment this charge is being assessed, counting every late fee charge on record for this same membership contract in that window, the base amount is increased by 50 percent (multiplied by 1.5) as a repeat-delinquency escalation, applied to the tier's own original base amount before any employer-funded reduction. Where there is no such prior late fee charge in that trailing 12-month window, no escalation applies and the tier's own base amount stands.

## Worked example (hypothetical)
A tier whose own base amount is $15.00, for a member with one prior late fee charge already on record within the trailing 12 months, escalates to $22.50 (the $15.00 base increased by 50 percent) before any employer-funded reduction is considered. For a member with no such prior late fee charge in that window, the same tier's charge stands at $15.00, with no escalation.

## Points of judgement
A member's very first late fee charge ever, with no prior late fee charge on record at all, never carries this repeat-delinquency increase, since the trailing 12-month window contains no prior occurrence to count; a second late fee charge occurring within 12 months of the first does carry it, regardless of how many months apart the two charges fall within that window.
